meta.title: Optimize draw shape pressure property
meta.body_summary: Refactor draw shape pressure storage: omit z field when no pressure (mouse), use integer 0-100 for pen pressure, and include migration to reduce data size and improve clarity.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor refactored pressure storage to omit z and use 0-100 ints; ds300 commented that impact is marginal and runtime dominated by derived data; PR closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 458 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium refactor by absolute volume, spanning 6 files. As a storage optimization PR, it was closed because the purported performance gains were challenged as insignificant compared to alternative approaches.

review_details.concern_detail: ds300 argued that the change won't significantly improve runtime memory or serialization size, and suggested more impactful approaches like base64 float16 arrays or gzip; the runtime cost is dominated by cached derived data, not raw points.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduced file size and improved data clarity by omitting z for non-pressure inputs and storing pressure as integer 0-100.
review_details.rejection_signals: ds300's comment directly questioned the optimization's value; maintainer closed without further iteration.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cursor's optimization targeted a specific data representation change but lacked benchmark evidence; maintainer expertise revealed that the real bottleneck lies elsewhere, indicating the agent's inability to assess system-level performance tradeoffs.

detection_detail.code_reading: ds300 reviewed the change and identified that runtime overhead is dominated by derived cached data, not raw point storage, and suggested alternative serialization strategies.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling data provided; only functional test plan.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After ds300's comment, the PR was closed by the author without further changes.

core_change_summary.description: In tldraw, refactored draw shape pressure handling: previously stored as float 0-1 in z property always; now omits z when no pressure (mouse), and stores integer 0-100 when pressure is present. Includes migration (OptimizePressure: 3) and updated tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The snapshot update is large (251 deletions) indicating test output changes; Vec.ts and geometry-types had minor adjustments.
change_trajectory: Single commit by Cursor agent: refactored pressure system across 6 files, updated tests and snapshots.
